resampling.justification: Taxi is a deterministic temporal tail holdout with stride sampling, not random IID rows. Select and justify group/block units using baseline-only data/provenance before marking reviewed.

data_provenance.split: LAST TAXI_N_TEST rows, late February; no shuffle
data_provenance.board_subset: tools/bench_board_more.py::prep uses classical_two_datasets.stride_rows for evaluation rows
data_provenance.time_features: TAXI_NUMERIC preserves pickup_hour, pickup_weekday and pickup_day; chronological order must be verified rather than inferred from file row index.

decision_owner: root; statistical output alone does not promote code
